question: 最近90天（2026年6月14日至9月12日）各地区各类别的销售金额最高的8个组合是哪些？（请给出地区、分类与金额）
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-06-14' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.region, c.name LIMIT 8
